name: startup-pressure-test
title_zh: 把创业点子拆到骨，给出能落地的强/弱/转 verdi
tagline_zh: 别等 BP 写完才发现问题不存在。它直接盘问：真需求、竞品、头 10 个客户、MVP、两周计划、创始人匹配度。
tagline_en: Don't wait until the deck is done to find out the problem isn't real. It grills: real need, competitors, first 10.
desc_en: Brutally evaluate and refine startup ideas with practical early-stage startup frameworks. Use when Codex is asked to pressure-test a startup idea, validate whether the problem is real, map competitors and current customer behavior, find the first 10 customers, define an MVP, create a 2-week launch plan, assess founder-market fit, or give a direct strong/weak/pivot verdict.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的创业清单，而是按早期框架逐项逼问，每项都要求具体证据；最后强制输出强/弱/转的二元结论。
why_en: Not a generic startup checklist — it interrogates each early-stage framework point for concrete evidence, then forces a.
limit_zh: 只评估点子本身，不写代码、不做市场调研、不生成完整 BP。若你已融资或产品上线，它按早期框架硬套，结论可能失真。
limit_en: Evaluates the idea only — no code, no live market research, no full BP. If you're funded or launched, it force-fits early-stage frames and may.
